full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white cinematic portrait shows a bald older man in a dark suit looking upward as several birds cross the pale sky above him. The man stands low and slightly left of center, with his broad coat and shoulders merging into a nearly black mass across the lower half. A white shirt collar and narrow dark tie remain visible beneath his chin. His face is lit from above, giving a pale highlight to the forehead and nose while the underside of the jaw falls into shadow. He tilts his head back and looks toward the left upper corner with a wary, concentrated expression. Behind him, a broad gray sky occupies most of the upper frame; its tonal variations resemble cloud and mist rather than a sharply defined location. A small dark bird passes near the upper left, its wings spread in a blurred diagonal. A much larger bird sweeps across the top center, partly cut by the frame, and another blurred winged shape crosses the right side below it. Their soft edges suggest rapid movement in contrast to the man's still, solid silhouette. The lower corners darken almost completely, enclosing the figure without revealing a clear ground surface. Light appears diffuse from the bright sky but stronger above the face, while the birds become stark black marks against pale gray. Fine grain and slight motion blur give the image the texture of an older film still. The overall composition sets a heavy stationary figure against unpredictable shapes in open sky, creating suspense through scale, contrast, and upward attention.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白电影式肖像呈现一位秃顶的年长男子身穿深色西装，仰望上方浅色天空里掠过的几只鸟。他站在画面较低、中央略偏左的位置，宽阔外套与肩膀融成覆盖下半部的近黑色块。白衬衫领和窄深色领带仍可在下巴下方看见。面孔受上方光照，前额和鼻子带浅色高光，下颌下面落入阴影。他仰起头看向左上角，神情警觉而专注。身后大片灰色天空占据上部大多数区域；调子变化像云与薄雾，而非轮廓鲜明的地点。左上方一只小黑鸟掠过，翅膀在模糊的斜线上张开。一只更大的鸟扫过上方中央，部分被画框裁切；另一道模糊翼形在更低的右侧穿过。鸟的软边暗示急速运动，与男子静止坚实的剪影相对。下方两角几乎完全变黑，把人物围住，却没有揭示明确地面。光似乎由明亮天空漫射而来，在脸的上方更强；飞鸟在浅灰底前成为鲜明黑色标记。细颗粒和轻微运动模糊使画面带旧电影剧照的肌理。整体构图以厚重静止的人影对照开放天空中难以预料的形状，通过尺度、反差与上望的注意制造悬念。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome photograph organizes suspense through a large near-black mass beneath a pale, open field. Softly graded gray light reveals a few selected planes, while fast dark shapes blur across otherwise quiet negative space. Edges range from firm and weighty at the focal mass to streaked and uncertain in moving accents. A bright diffuse background supplies the main illumination, leaving lower areas strongly shadowed. Fine film grain gives the smooth sky and lit surfaces a subdued tactile finish. The composition keeps its visual weight low, so small interruptions above feel unusually forceful and unstable.
style_prompt_zh: 这种单色摄影以浅色开阔区域下方的大块近黑形体组织悬念。柔和渐层的灰光只揭示几个选定平面，快速暗形则模糊地掠过其余安静留白。边缘从焦点色块的坚实厚重变为运动重音的拖曳与不确定。明亮漫射背景提供主要照明，下方区域因此保持强烈阴影。细胶片颗粒给平滑天空与亮面一种压低的可触完成感。构图把视觉重量放低，使上方的小型打断显得格外有力而不稳定。
theme_en: A wary older man beneath birds crossing a cloudy sky
theme_zh: 一位警觉的年长男子站在飞鸟掠过的阴云天空下
name: Alfred Hitchcock
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
